payload.description:
As an agent, I want a first-class command to git-commit project/issues, so that I do not have to remember the git add/commit ritual.

Decision: add `kbs commit` (not `kbs sync` — sync is Jira/Snyk/GitHub). Keep existing CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md docs and point them at this command. Commit project/issues only. Do not push. Do not un-gitignore project/events.

Feature: Commit board state
  Scenario: Commit persists uncommitted issue files
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And an uncommitted issue exists
    When I run "kanbus commit"
    Then the command should succeed
    And the issue files are committed to git

  Scenario: Commit succeeds when there is nothing to commit
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And the working tree has no uncommitted issue files
    When I run "kanbus commit"
    Then the command should succeed
payload.title: Commit board state with kbs commit
